【PENTHOUSE GROOVE DJ Live Streaming vol.10 "PEACE" 】

Love is everywhere. Connected by music, united by love.

This time, we're sharing a transition scene from "Gol-e Gandom – Lloyd Miller" into "王家の谷とファラオの呪い – Unknown Artist".

Please enjoy the marriage of oriental and psychedelic jazz, a mysterious world reminiscent of Egyptian curses, and a somewhat magical narration that progresses indifferently.
